blockers.finding: The binding split.row_group_count is 20000, which is the per-sequence time-axis row count. Comparing it with len(SequenceFile) is incorrect: the registered F0 split has 1405 fit-valid plus 468 evaluation valid row groups, total 1873.
blockers.required_repair: Bind a distinct sequence_rows=20000 and valid_row_group_count=1873; derive the full-valid count from the canonical split components/nodes, validate fit-valid/evaluation membership against it, and compare SequenceFile length to the valid-row-group count before output mutation.

blockers.finding: The blanket symlink checks reject the already registered data alias. The exact pinned AllThree fit admission records the lexical valid.parquet path, resolved path, islink=false, bytes, device, inode, mtime_ns, and registered hash; the lexical path resolves through the approved data alias.
blockers.required_repair: Bind the exact fit admission bytes/SHA and its data_identity_stats_only entry. Before split loading or SequenceFile access, require exact lexical path, exact expected resolved file and parent paths, a non-symlink regular leaf, and fresh stat identity matching registered bytes/device/inode/mtime. Permit only that exact registered alias; reject any other traversal.

decision: Do not stage or execute this frozen draft; repair only the two findings and request a new independent source review.
review_scope: Frozen local exporter and binding metadata only; no tests, imports, model/array/data payloads, B staging, or remote action performed by this review.
